rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attacking physically or forcefully attacking a person or idea with words.

example.english: They suddenly attack their opponents on the field.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺球場上突然攻擊對手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 dat6 jin4 gung1 gik1 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an attack, including a general or planned physical assault, an attack on a person or idea, and a military attack.

example.english: That article came under a lot of attack online.
example.traditional: 嗰篇文章喺網上受到好多攻擊。
example.jyutping: go2 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 sau6 dou2 hou2 do1 gung1 gik1

rows.note: Use this for a sudden or surprise physical assault on someone or something.

example.english: Someone carried out an attack on my friend last night.
example.traditional: 噚日夜晚有人襲擊咗我朋友。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 je6 maan5 jau5 jan4 zaap6 gik1 zo2 ngo5 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this for a sudden episode or recurrence of an illness or medical condition.

example.english: I had an asthma attack last night and couldn't sleep all night.
example.traditional: 我尋晚哮喘發作，成晚瞓唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 haau1 cyun2 faat3 zok3 sing4 maan5 fan3 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when you start working directly on a task, especially in phrases such as 埋手做功課.

example.english: I attack my homework as soon as I finish dinner.
example.traditional: 我食完飯就埋手做功課。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 maai4 sau2 zou6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this for an illness or symptom beginning to affect someone or flaring up, rather than for physical assault.

example.english: My asthma is having an attack.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 haau1 cyun2 faat3 zok3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something acts destructively by eating away at or degrading a material or system.

example.english: Seawater will attack the rocks along the shore.
example.traditional: 海水會侵蝕岸邊嘅石頭。
example.jyutping: hoi2 seoi2 wui5 cam1 sik6 ngon6 bin1 ge3 sek6 tau4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an attack that targets a computer system or network.

example.english: This website came under a network attack yesterday.
example.traditional: 呢個網站噚日受到網絡攻擊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 cam4 jat6 sau6 dou3 mong5 lok3 gung1 gik1
